text: 从国家税务总局获悉，目前，离岸信托收益征税政策过渡期已平稳结束，绝大多数纳税人积极配合，累计申报离岸信托个人所得税超1600亿元，其中10月当月入库超1200亿元，带动了全国10月份个人所得税收入增长近90%。2026年7月24日，财政部、税务总局发布《关于离岸信托个人所得税有关事项的公告》，规定取得离岸信托收益的纳税人在90天过渡期内完成申报缴税，不加收滞纳金。 (新华社)
text_en: The State Taxation Administration said that the transition period for the tax policy on offshore trust income has now ended smoothly, with the vast majority of taxpayers actively cooperating, and a cumulative total of over 160 billion yuan in individual income tax on offshore trust income declared, of which more than 120 billion yuan was collected in October alone, driving a nearly 90% increase in national individual income tax revenue in October. On July 24, 2026, the Ministry of Finance and the State Taxation Administration issued the Announcement on Matters Concerning Individual Income Tax on Offshore Trusts, stipulating that taxpayers receiving offshore trust income must complete declaration and tax payment within a 90-day transition period, without late fees. (Xinhua News Agency)
